verdict.rationale: Fellow's ReadMe-hosted API reference has a live "Try It!" request panel on every endpoint page, backed by an OpenAPI 3.1 document, with llms.txt and per-page .md mirrors. That covers the interactive, runnable core of the story. However, requests run only against a live workspace behind paid-plan and admin-enablement gates, and no sandbox or test workspace is documented, which limits how freely the examples can be run. missing for 10: a sandbox or test environment for running examples without touching live data, runnable access without paid-plan or admin gating, a Fellow-hosted downloadable OpenAPI spec (developers.fellow.ai/openapi.json returns 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Try It experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
